title: 006-N3 · Two redirect requests open two transfers
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Pella Rusk. From the case card: the customer has already selected an available staffed pickup point for DL-006, and routing confirms the parcel is eligible for redirection before delivery.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: pass the customer's choice to routing, get the pickup point's confirmation and give the customer the collection instructions.

recipient.name: Pella Rusk
recipient.responsibility: Choose the pickup point instead of home delivery and collect the parcel there.

routing.responsibility: Redirect the eligible parcel to the chosen pickup point on the customer's recorded choice.

pickup_point.name: Copperfin Counter supervisor
pickup_point.responsibility: Confirm the physical receipt of the parcel and state the collection terms.

goal: Get DL-006 redirected to the customer's chosen pickup point, get the pickup point's confirmation that the parcel is available, and give the customer the collection instructions.
limits: Do not treat ready for collection as collected.
Do not invent a universal identification requirement.
Do not create a second operational change, booking, charge or credit.
